plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.3.2 adds SUPERSKILLRET_SCOPE env var to restrict retrieval to the user pool only (or system pool only) — useful for project-specific curated skill sets. v0.3.1 adds /superskillret:setup for one-shot sync install + daemon spawn. v0.3.0 PLUGIN_ROOT resolution. v0.2.9 Python 3.9 compat. v0.2.8 daemon health line + list/remove cli. v0.2.0–0.2.7 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
